blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Senior kegler Orly Enoveso captured his first Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) shootout tournament title in a closely contested competition at the SM Seaside Bowling and Leisure Center on Sunday, October 11. The 87-year-old Enoveso proved that he still has the aim and swing on the lanes, tallying 822 pinfalls to outlast 20 other bowlers in the four-game series. Enoveso saved his best game for last, scoring 219 pinfalls in the final round.
